mentions.name: Rural Digital Community Infrastructure Platform
mentions.description: A modular, locally owned digital community infrastructure platform for rural areas that wraps current workflows rather than replacing them. Its pilot launches this month in partnership with the newspaper of record and local radio stations covering four rural counties in the New York Catskills, with plans to offer it to other regions through the same partnership model if the pilot shows promise.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been working for the past few years building robust, locally owned digital community infrastructure for rural areas.

The pilot is being released this month in partnership with the newspaper of record and local radio stations that cover four rural counties in the New York Catskills.

It's a modular platform that wraps current workflows, rather than replace them.
